content.value: Cranks Dungeons rebuilds Minecraft around action-RPG character progression. Your level, class, passive routes, equipment bases, rune affixes, enchantment slots, elemental damage, ailments, recovery, parties, gathering progression, and horse bloodlines all matter.

Passive Skill Tree: powered by combat levels. It defines your combat build and grants primary attributes, damage, defences, recovery, and build-changing keystones.
World Tree: powered by gathering XP and non-combat vanilla XP. It is a separate network intended for gathering and world utility.

Find or craft a useful equipment base.
Meet its Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence requirements.
For eligible non-Unique equipment, use runic tomes at a Runic Altar to change rarity and add, replace, remove, or reroll affixes.
Use targeted tomes when you need a guaranteed family of stats.
Raise base quality and add enchantment slots at the Quality Station.
Compare the final character totals in the inventory stats panel.

Runes, enchantments, quality, rarity, and material tier are different systems. A high-rarity item can still have poor rune tiers, and a low material base can restrict the best random tier it can roll.

Classes and both tree layouts are supplied by the server. A modpack or server owner can change node names, routes, bonuses, icons, and class starting values. This guide explains the rules enforced by the mod and identifies the built-in class setup currently shipped with it.
